requirements.requirement: The system must inject triage data from the chat response payload into the ChatWindow message processing pipeline.
The system must render triage explanations within the corresponding MessageBubble component for each clinical trial result.
The system must preserve message ordering such that triage-enhanced messages appear in the same sequence as the original chat response.
The system must pass triage data to MessageBubble using the contract defined in EVAL-CT-TRIAGE-UX-S1 without schema transformation errors.
The system must ensure that triage content is rendered using the formatting and prioritization logic implemented in EVAL-CT-TRIAGE-UX-S2.
The system must support rendering multiple trial triage results within a single chat response without overwriting or collapsing entries.
The system must not block or delay rendering of non-triage chat content if triage data is present in the same response.
The system must gracefully render the MessageBubble without triage content if the triage field is absent from the response payload.
The system must fall back to standard text rendering if triage data is malformed or fails schema validation.
The system must correctly associate each triage explanation with its corresponding clinical trial identifier in the chat response.
The system must ensure that triage-enhanced MessageBubble components re-render correctly on state updates without duplicating content.
The system must maintain compatibility with existing MessageBubble props and not break rendering of non-trial messages.
The system must ensure that triage content is only rendered for clinical trial message types and not for unrelated chat messages.
The system must log an error event when triage data is expected but missing from a response that includes clinical trial results.
